title: Serialized Reference-floor application/provider paired timing
reason: The canonical transaction layer cannot provide a valid single-physical-advance prescribed-head timing fixture without either external full-half acceptance or changing transaction semantics. The existing serialized backend reference-floor entrypoint executes one physical Reference advance through normal FMR parameter configuration, adaptive opt-in routing, provider binding and cache without temporal acceptance overhead.
comparison: same serialized Reference backend physical advance with adaptive_hydraulics_active false versus true

timing_policy.compiler: gfortran -O3 without runtime checks or floating-point traps
timing_policy.adaptive_representation_build: one untimed adaptive warm-up/sample before timed batches

interpretation_boundary: Measures serialized FMR routing plus one physical Reference advance. It is not canonical transaction timing and not a whole-SWAP or MultiSWAP speed claim.
